honestConclusion.efficacy: THIS RUN IS NOT EVIDENCE THAT adaptive-strategy PROVIDES ANY BENEFIT. Both arms achieved all 4 tasks on both repeats (16/16), so every one of the 8 paired comparisons is a tie (successRateDelta 0, bootstrap 95% interval [0,0]). The corpus is at the ceiling for gpt-5.6-terra; there is no headroom in which a strategy could show a win, and the result must not be promoted as a strategy improvement.
honestConclusion.decisiveCaveat: The advisory persona multi-child mechanism never engaged in any of the 16 cells: costs.children.modelCalls = 0 in every cell, goal native.strategies = [], and each meter observed exactly one '-g1' parent session with no child session. The adaptive arm therefore degenerated to 'the same parent agent taking extra rounds', not to the intended skeptical/alternative persona consultation. Paired coordination extra.modelCalls spans -4..+2 (sum -3) and is pure parent-call noise, not coordination cost.
honestConclusion.whatThisRunDoesProve: Engineering reliability only: the corpus->doctor->plan->run->report chain works end-to-end against real TraeX under a realistic time budget — 16/16 completed, zero retained traces, zero fabricated tokens or cost, evidence content-addressed and independently re-verified by `report` (exit 0). It validates the measurement plumbing, not the intelligence hypothesis.

timeBudgetCalibration.rootCause: The original 60000ms goals step-admission wall clock was mismatched to real TraeX latency (~10s per settled call). Step-expiry is the designed normal paused lifecycle (execution timer -> cancel -> revoked -> finish(false)); the meter fail-closed marks the in-flight aborted request retained and assertComplete refuses the cell, which the runner records as unknown/adapter-error and fails fast.

before.recorded: 7 rows: 6 completed/achieved, 1 unknown/adapter-error, then fail-fast halt (16 expected)

failingCell.interpretation: cell activity spanned 66.8s (> 60s step gate); at least the three cells whose model activity spanned 64.1/71.4/79.1s were guaranteed to hit the old gate

after.invariants: verification.maxDurationMs*cases.length < stepDuration and stepDuration*3 < budget.durationMs; the longest cell (83.9s) leaves ~36s headroom under the 120s gate

adversarialChecks.quiescenceIsNotCompleteness: upheld: scheduler quiescence does not prove ledger completeness; aborting on the step gate is a designed paused lifecycle and assertComplete correctly refuses it
adversarialChecks.noHardBudgetChange: raising the wall clock does not raise modelCalls=16 / toolCalls=32 hard ceilings; both arms share the identical symmetric step gate
adversarialChecks.failClosedDispatch: an aborted in-flight request stays heldCalls (the server effect cannot be proven absent); counting it settled would violate goals budget 'No refunds on dispatch uncertainty' / 'False never proves absence of effects'
adversarialChecks.wallClockIsNotASafetyBoundary: 60s vs 120s is a scheduling/liveness parameter; safety is provided by Docker, the route allow-list and hard budgets, and 120s stays bounded
adversarialChecks.eFix: the strategy-meter change only relabels the retained reason from meterSignal.aborted to the merged requestSignal (which includes the step-level options.signal); phase=retained, heldCalls and assertComplete failure are identical, so zero control-flow effect. In this run all 16 cells settled with zero retained, so that catch path never executed.

limits: No efficacy claim: 8 ties, delta 0, ceiling corpus, promotionAuthorized=false. This cannot be read as adaptive-strategy being equal-or-better beyond these four easy tasks.
Persona multi-child coordination was never exercised (16/16 children=0); the central strategy hypothesis is untested by this run.
call-count mode measures call counts and wall latency only; tokens and dollar cost are structurally unavailable (0/null), not merely unmeasured.
n=2 repeats over 4 tasks gives a very small paired sample and a [0,0] bootstrap interval.
Artifacts live outside the git repo in a private run directory; hashes travel here but absence on another machine is not fresh validation.
Code was uncommitted at run time; binding is via planDigest/capability hash, not a signed release commit.
nextPrerequisites: Determine why the advisory persona child is never spawned (trigger predicate vs assembly/wiring defect); investigation in progress against assistant-goals/src/strategy.ts and the benchmark adaptive arm.

If persona engagement is failure/round-gated by design, drive a real goal into that state (first-round verifier failure -> round 2) and/or adopt a harder corpus where gpt-5.6-terra does not ceiling, then re-run the same paired call-count protocol. Coordination/extra metering is already in place and will observe child calls as soon as they occur.
